0022600122.text: The Miami Heat, 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Dallas Mavericks, who are 1-1 after two games, in the Heat's fourth game of the 2026-27 season. Miami sits 5th in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, and 15th in the East, while Dallas is 3rd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 9th in the West, with Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation) all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, and their most recent meeting was on December 3, 2025, in Dallas, where the Mavericks won 118-108.
